about: Brief 22's judge outputs that moved from brief 21's (numbers-same.json, 'final'), each read against what brief 22 changed and its criterion; and the judge's figures that moved (none: all 36 of brief 21's figures are the same, and Genre Audit-R is new). Read by judge.py ('files') and criteria.py ('figures').

journey-beginner-bj-0.json.why: a taped brief's genre part moved by brief 22's credit rule: a genre's own knowledge and the best directly related one now count together, 1 − (1 − own) × (1 − related), and a related genre counts 0.65 toward its broad genre and 0.40 toward its kind (0.75 and 0.5 until brief 22); a take moves at most 0.6 either way, and L3-R's verdict, read from l3r.json, is brief 21's: met, (b) on 8 journeys, (c) growth 1.253 at least
